newsitem.title: UK: OVERSEAS ACQUISITIONS OF UK FIRMS FALLS IN Q2.
newsitem.headline: OVERSEAS ACQUISITIONS OF UK FIRMS FALLS IN Q2.

text.p: Expenditure on company acquisitions in Britain by overseas companies fell to 2.7 billion stg in the second quarter, the Office for National Statistics said on Tuesday.
In the first quarter, acquisitions totalled a record 6.2 billion pounds, reflecting the acquisition of a number of electricity companies by overseas firms.
Expenditure on overseas acquisitions by British companies dropped to 2.2 billion pounds in the second quarter, from 4.1 billion in the first.
Spending on acquisitions of British companies by other UK firms totalled 1.8 billion, continuing the low level recorded in Q1, the ONS said.
